_about: Module definitions for the movers group. See logistics.json for the shape. `tech` names the research that unlocks the Build button; `tether` keeps a joined face hooked however far the load goes.

modules.name: Winch
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Pays its cable out as the Cutter deepens the shaft and hauls the Tank back up when it is full, then lets it down again once the Funnel has emptied it. Drill Shaft research lengthens the cable.

modules.name: Piston
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Pushes whatever is joined to its mechanical face straight out along it and pulls it back. Click it to run, hold out or hold back. Draws power while it moves.

modules.name: Gantry
modules.blurb: A bolted rail. Whatever is joined to its mechanical face rides along the rail, up to 80 cells from where it was mounted. Click it to run, hold out or hold back. Draws power while it moves.

modules.name: Turntable
modules.blurb: A pinned hub with a mechanical face on each side. It turns about its middle and swings everything joined to its faces round with it. Click it to hold at a quarter turn, step by quarter turns or spin. Draws power while it turns.
